commercialPurpose: Convert portfolio interest through a contact form that still preserves the designer visual identity.
purposeLayer: Contact section pairs form fields with branded media proof so the close does not become a generic form slab.
anatomyLayer: Dark heading, stacked input fields, message field, yellow CTA, adjacent portrait/project media card, small availability/status card, and minimal footer links.
hierarchyLayer: Contact headline first, form fields second, media proof third.
gridRhythmLayer: Dark contact split with form stack on one side and branded image/status card on the other.
originalityLayer: Extract section grammar only; do not copy exact artwork, imagery, spacing, copy, color identity, brand marks, product photos, or page order.
usageRuleLayer: Use when portfolio and agency templates need a contact section with brand memory, not a detached form.
layoutGesture: dark portfolio contact split with media proof card
sectionSilhouette: black section where a form panel is balanced by a yellow-toned project/portrait card
compositionTension: conversion utility remains visually tied to the portfolio art direction
focalPath: headline to form fields to media card to submit CTA
negativeSpaceShape: dark blank areas frame form and media as separate conversion blocks
depthLayering: black base, input surfaces, image card, status chip, accent button
moduleScaleVariation: medium form block against one medium media proof card and small status chip
breakoutBehavior: media proof card overlaps the simple form rhythm
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy Caos form styling, portrait/photo, yellow accent, or footer layout.
